'''Aurefold''' is a long-running low-fantasy series in mystic realism. Its tagline: ''"The map ends where the truth begins."''

Ten Great Houses have ruled [[the Banner-lands]] since the [[War of the Unification]] ended four hundred years ago, and each is less a family than a philosophy of leadership. The reader's question is never which house is good — it is: '''which house would you follow?'''

The name of the world: ''aure'' — a low gold light, the gleam of a coal not yet gone to ash; ''fold'' — an old word for held country, the ground where a flock is kept through the dark. Aurefold: the kept land under a failing light.
